requirements.text: Do not remove or alter any existing feature, test, or screen in the freelance finance tracker.
The Receipt add button must never overlay or cover any part of the Recent activity list.
The Mileage add button must never overlay or cover any part of the Recent activity list.
The "Receipt saved" confirmation message must never overlay or cover any part of the Recent activity list.
Each row in the Recent activity list must display its amount value.
The Recent activity list must be scrollable past the Receipt and Mileage add buttons, allowing the buttons to remain fixed while the list scrolls.
On a device with a screen resolution of 390x844 pixels, all bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible without truncation.
